items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Was it Herbie Steward... in the saxophone section back then?' and the interviewee responds by discussing the quality of the players in that section, implying Herbie Steward was a colleague in the band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. We’d just think of it that part of your salary was going to come out to pay for your room & board so to speak.
So who were in the saxophone section back then? Was it Herbie Steward, and was Zoot Sims there during your stay?
